name: Clearing Party And Time 23
definition: Specifies the central counterparty intended clearing time.

CCP.name: CCP
CCP.definition: Identifies the central counterparty (CCP) that cleared the transaction.

ClearingReceiptDateTime.name: Clearing Receipt Date Time
ClearingReceiptDateTime.definition: Time and date when the original derivative was received by the central counterparty for clearing.

ClearingDateTime.name: Clearing Date Time
ClearingDateTime.definition: Time and date when clearing took place.

ClearingIdentifier.name: Clearing Identifier
ClearingIdentifier.definition: Unique identifier of each clearing derivative that replaces the original derivative that was submitted for clearing to the central counterparty, other than the identifier for the transaction being reported.

OriginalIdentifier.name: Original Identifier
OriginalIdentifier.definition: Unique identifier of the original derivative submitted for clearing to the central counterparty that is replaced by the clearing derivative.

OriginalTradeRepositoryIdentifier.name: Original Trade Repository Identifier
OriginalTradeRepositoryIdentifier.definition: Identifies the trade repository to which the original derivative was reported.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one of the 6 elements must be present.
